lines: An item's budget for runic crafting: 65 on every ordinary piece of equipment. Each runic action costs 15 plus the costs of its glyphs (alloys cost no potential); a critical craft costs half. At zero the item still works, but runic crafting is closed. Repairs and workbench upgrades do not restore it. Base jewels have potential too.
